messages:
maya (sec-eng): Heads-up — legal asked for a clear onboarding checklist for customer-supplied keys. Can we sketch RBAC, audit, and fallback requirements?
omar (infra): +1. We should separate 'key-admin' (create/import, rotate) and 'key-operator' (attach/use) roles. Minimal principle.
lexi (compliance): Needed for audits: proof of attestation when key material is loaded, a signed receipt, and a record of the KMS key ID tied to customer tenant. SOC2 appendix expects the chain.
sanjay (platform): For HSM-backed imports: we need the attestation blob from the HSM vendor and an import session id. Suggest storing only the import receipt (hash), not raw blobs.
maya (sec-eng): Agreed. Can we capture what fields the audit log must show? Thinking: action, actor, role, key-id, import-session-id, attestation-hash, timestamp, source-ip, request-id.
omar (infra): That matches our log schema. We should also log the KMS-wrapped key operations: Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign with key version and latency.
lexi (compliance): Also retention policy: logs must be immutable for 7 years for certain customers. Need an escalation path if logs are missing.
sanjay (platform): Implementation note: RBAC change will be a new iam role "redwood/key-admin" and a scoped binding to the customer's org. We'll add least-privilege policies in terraform.
maya (sec-eng): Can someone draft the PR checklist for ops runbooks? E.g., steps for import, attestation verify, role grant, smoke test, rollback.
omar (infra): I'll start a draft PR: https://git.local/redwood/infra/pulls/5823 (WIP). It will include terraform snippet and an apply/runbook.
ci-bot: deploy status — infra/pr-5823 created, CI pending.
lexi (compliance): Also add a test for customer key revocation: simulated revocation and assert failover to fallback model (hosted key) with explicit customer consent flow. Document consent logging.
sanjay (platform): Triage play for incidents: if attestation fails post-import, we quarantine the tenant, mark key unusable, and notify security + customer. Need SLAs on notification windows.
maya (sec-eng): For notifications: security oncall + account owner within 30m, and a public incident page if service impact > 10% of requests.
omar (infra): Question: do we allow operator-level key export to an external HSM? I'd say no by default. Add an exception process requiring signed approval and secondary approver.
lexi (compliance): Document exception workflow and retention of approval artifacts. Also link to DLP controls for any key material handling.
maya (sec-eng): Quick sample config snippet we can include in PR for audit extraction: 
```
SELECT timestamp, actor, role, action, key_id, import_session, attestation_hash, req_id
FROM key_audit_log
WHERE tenant_id = '{{tenant}}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
sanjay (platform): Nice. We'll add automated checks that run weekly to ensure every active key has an attestation_hash and import_session present. Alert if count < threshold.
omar (infra): I'll include an RBAC migration job that maps old "admin" to new granular roles and outputs a report.
maya (sec-eng): Action items: Omar — PR + terraform (EOD Wed). Sanjay — automation tests for attestation (next week). Lexi — compliance doc draft (legal artifacts + retention) by Friday. I'll own the incident play and runbook.
lexi (compliance): Sounds good. Ping me for review when PR is ready.
omar (infra): Will do. Adding acceptance tests in CI to block merge until runbook exists.
ci-bot: CI queued: infra/pr-5823 — acceptance tests will run post-runbook check.
maya (sec-eng): Thanks all. We'll review in tomorrow standup for any gaps. :thumbsup:
